summary: Chip stocks fell Tuesday and gave back part of Monday's big rebound. Bitcoin slipped to about 60,000 dollars. I found no trading halts or exchange outages. The FBI crime-database probe and the USDA incident continue, and no official source links them.

events.title: FBI probes suspected breach of its national crime database
events.impact: Police use NCIC for warrant, stolen-vehicle and missing-person checks. It holds over 18 million records. Reports do not say if data was copied or changed. No new FBI update found today.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. The FBI declined to comment to the AP. No attacker has been named. No official source links this to earlier FBI incidents.

events.title: USDA cyber incident hit farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan, payment and conservation systems went offline so passwords could be reset. An official said most should be back by Friday, with work possible over the weekend. I found no notice of full restoration.
events.stated_cause: A USDA under secretary called it a cyberthreat and said no data was lost. USDA has not named an attacker or given a full public account of what was affected.

events.title: Iran says four more tankers hit mines near Strait of Hormuz
events.impact: Iran's navy says four tankers caught fire in about 24 hours, three of them under US escort. These are Iranian claims. The UK maritime agency separately confirmed vessels were hit. CBS says oil prices are still slowly falling.
events.stated_cause: Iran says mines. Nobody has claimed the earlier projectile hits. CNBC cites the WSJ saying the US is probing Iran over cyberattacks on tankers. That is a report, not an official finding.

events.title: US tech stocks fall Tuesday after Monday's big rebound
events.impact: Price check: S&P 500 about -0.5% to -1% midday near 7,160-7,200 after Monday's close of 7,237 (+4.73%). Nasdaq down about 1.5% to 2.4%. Nvidia down about 7% and AMD about 9%. No trading halts found.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite AI spending doubts, tariff plans and rate worries. Sources differ slightly on the size of the drop because they quote different times. No technical fault or cyber attack reported.

events.title: Bitcoin near 60K USD, down 2-5% on the day and about 7-8% on the week
events.impact: Price check: Coinbase 59,757 (-2.3%); CoinGecko 59,551 (-4.9%); Bitget 60,066 (-2%). Quotes differ by timing but agree on direction. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. The drop moves with the tech-stock pullback and Fed worries.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows partial outage on Sites and Services
events.impact: Cloudflare's own status feed lists Sites and Services as a partial outage, last changed 13:38 UTC today. Amsterdam is back to normal. I found no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

events.title: Spotify login problems for many users
events.impact: Thousands reported being unable to log in. TechRadar's live blog said it looked over by about 12:30 UTC. Spotify's status page showed no incident.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Spotify said it was checking the issues. No official source reports a cyber attack.

events.title: Delta computer outage delayed flights; crews used manual math
events.impact: About 1,654 of 5,000 Delta flights were delayed Sunday. Crews used manual workarounds until automation returned. No Delta problem is in the FAA feed now.
events.stated_cause: Delta blamed its weight and balance system. The FAA said the delays were not related to air traffic control systems. No official source reports a cyber attack.

events.title: FAA ground stop at Las Vegas airport for staffing
events.impact: The FAA feed at 17:29 UTC shows no ground stops or delays. It lists only long-running closures to some private aircraft at LAX, San Diego and Las Vegas.
events.stated_cause: The FAA had listed staffing for the Las Vegas ground stop. No equipment failure or cyber attack was listed.

events.title: CISA adds two more actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers Project MONAI MONAI Label and N-able Mail Assure. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not tie the flaws to the USDA or FBI incidents.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The FBI and USDA incidents have no stated cause and no named attacker. Delta blamed its own system, and the FAA said air traffic control was not involved. Stocks and Bitcoin are moving on AI, tariff and rate worries. No official source links any of these.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same attacker or company for the FBI and USDA incidents, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: No confirmed link between incidents and no sign of widespread failure. Markets are volatile but trading normally.

prep_note: No action needed for most people. Expect more swings in tech stocks and crypto, so avoid rushed trades. Farmers should check the FSA or USDA office for the status of payments and loans. Keep some cash on hand, as you should anyway.
